s=s.replace('''    # The body event id is the replay identity on purpose: the Idempotency-Key header is a per-delivery gateway trace and changes when a provider retries (PAY-418).
''','''    # Providers in HEADER_KEY_PROVIDERS mint a new body event id on retry
    # (po_1844 -> po_1844.2) but resend the same Idempotency-Key, so the header

    # since their Idempotency-Key is a per-delivery trace that changes on retry
    # (PAY-418).
''')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
cat >> tests/test_intake.py <<'EOF'


def test_harbor_retry_with_a_new_event_id_is_not_applied_twice():
    intake = Intake()
    first = intake.apply(hook("harbor", "po_1844", "8f3c1a9e0b27d4c6"))
    again = intake.apply(hook("harbor", "po_1844.2", "8f3c1a9e0b27d4c6"))
    assert first.applied is True
    assert again.applied is False
    assert again.duplicate is True
    assert intake.ledger.balance("acct-44") == 18_000
    assert len(intake.ledger.entries) == 1


def test_distinct_harbor_keys_both_settle():
    intake = Intake()
    intake.apply(hook("harbor", "po_1", "8f3c1a9e0b27d4c6", amount=18_000))
    intake.apply(hook("harbor", "po_2", "1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e", amount=2_000))
    assert intake.ledger.balance("acct-44") == 20_000
EOF
